cases.input: One dataset version is released in CSV and Parquet.
cases.expect: Both distributions have separate fixity and bind the same pinned contract version.

cases.input: A contract successor is declared backward-compatible after assessment.
cases.expect: Compatibility mode, outcome and evidence are explicit and the dataset version references the successor.

cases.input: Dataset content changes without a contract change.
cases.expect: A successor dataset version may bind the unchanged contract version with provenance.

cases.input: Distributions of one dataset version bind different contract versions.
cases.expect: The release is rejected as incoherent.

cases.input: A dataset references the latest contract URL without version or digest.
